ghcr.io/stacklok/dockyard/npx/sentry-mcp.overview:
## Sentry MCP Server

The sentry MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) service for human-in-the-loop coding agents and developer workflow debugging. The server enables comprehensive Sentry project and organization management, real-time error tracking with event search and issue monitoring, AI-powered issue analysis through Sentry Seer integration, and integrated documentation search for platform guidance.

tool_definitions.description:
Create a Sentry Alert (notification workflow) that sends Slack, email, PagerDuty, or other notifications when its connected issue streams or monitors trigger.
get_alert_options lists valid actions, conditions, and sources; update_alert_rule adds sources to an existing Alert.
Monitors are separate tools: find_metric_monitors (metric thresholds), find_monitors (cron jobs), find_uptime_monitors (URL checks).
After a timeout or error, search for the Alert before retrying: it may already exist.

actionFilters.description: Action groups with conditions and notification actions, from get_alert_options or copied from get_alert_rule. Component IDs are dropped; integration and destination IDs are kept. Pass [] for none.

config.description: Provider config. Slack and Teams: set targetDisplay to the channel name in the integrationId workspace; Sentry resolves the ID. Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email: set targetIdentifier; a new display name alone keeps the old target.

detectorIds.description: Monitor source IDs from get_alert_options. Pass [] for an Alert with no sources; it sends nothing until connected. An all-project source also needs org:write.

environment.description: Environment the Alert applies to. Null means all environments.

frequencyMinutes.description: Minimum interval between notifications, in minutes.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

projectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams to connect. Set this, detector IDs, or both.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.
Trigger conditions, in the shape get_alert_rule returns; copied IDs are dropped. Null or an empty group means no triggers.

tool_definitions.description:
Create a Sentry Metric Monitor that detects when a metric, such as an error count or latency, crosses a static, percent-change, or dynamic threshold. New monitors start active.
Copy a monitor's setup from get_metric_monitor_details. Notifications come from Alerts: create_alert_rule. Cron jobs: find_monitors. URL checks: find_uptime_monitors.
Creation can persist before an error or timeout; check find_metric_monitors before retrying.

conditionGroup.description: Complete detection conditions; copied IDs are dropped. Static and Percent use threshold conditions, including a resolved one. Dynamic uses one anomaly_detection condition.

comparison.description: Threshold value. For Percent detection it is an absolute percentage of the earlier window: 110 means 10% higher.

config.description: Detection mode: Static thresholds, Percent change against an earlier window (needs comparisonDeltaSeconds), or Dynamic anomaly detection (needs enough history).

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

query.description: Complete metric query. Omit environment for all environments.

dataset.description: `metrics` is crash-free releases. `events_analytics_platform` covers spans, logs, and application metrics, chosen by eventTypes.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

workflowIds.description: Alert workflow IDs to connect, from find_alert_rules with `issue`. Omit to create with no Alerts.

tool_definitions.description:
Create a Sentry cron monitor that alerts on missed, failed, or slow runs of a scheduled job. Uptime URL checks: find_uptime_monitors. Metric thresholds: find_metric_monitors.
The job must send check-ins with the returned slug (SDK monitor config or sentry monitor run).
A disabled status you did not request means no cron seat was free: tell the user; it ignores check-ins until enabled.
After an error or timeout, check find_monitors before retrying.

checkInMargin.description: Minutes after the expected time before a check-in counts as missed. Sentry treats 0 as 1.

failureIssueThreshold.description: Consecutive failed or missed check-ins before an issue opens.

maxRuntime.description: Minutes a check-in may stay in progress before it fails.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

recoveryThreshold.description: Consecutive successful check-ins before the issue resolves.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

schedule.description: Job schedule: a crontab, or an interval such as every 15 minutes.

crontab.description: Five-field crontab schedule or `@` alias, e.g. `0 3 * * *` or `@daily`. Seconds fields are not supported.

slug.description: Slug that check-ins use. Derived from the name when omitted.

status.description: Monitor status. Disabled monitors ignore check-ins.

timezone.description: tz database timezone for the schedule, e.g. `UTC`.

workflowIds.description: Alert workflow IDs to connect, from find_alert_rules with `issue`.

config.description: Provider config. Slack and Teams: set targetDisplay to the channel name in the integrationId workspace; Sentry resolves the ID. Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email: set targetIdentifier; a new display name alone keeps the old target.

addDetectorIds.description: Monitor source IDs to connect, from get_alert_options sources. An all-project source also needs org:write.

addProjectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams to connect.

items.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

environment.description: Environment the Alert applies to. Null means all environments.

frequencyMinutes.description: Minimum interval between notifications, in minutes.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

tool_definitions.description: Update a DSN (client key) on a Sentry project: rename it, activate or deactivate it, set or remove its rate limit, or change JavaScript Loader Script options. Returns the settings Sentry saved; tell the user if any requested setting did not change.

browserSdkVersion.description: JavaScript SDK version the Loader Script serves, such as `latest` or `8.x`.

disableRateLimit.description: True removes the rate limit. Do not combine with rateLimitWindow or rateLimitCount.

isActive.description: False stops the key from accepting events.

loaderHasDebug.description: Loader Script: use the debug bundle with SDK logging.

loaderHasLogsAndMetrics.description: Loader Script: enable logs and metrics. Requires SDK 10.0.0 or later.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

rateLimitCount.description: Maximum events accepted per window. Requires rateLimitWindow.

rateLimitWindow.description: Rate limit window in seconds. Requires rateLimitCount.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

tool_definitions.description: Update a Sentry issue: resolve, ignore (archive), or reopen it, assign it to a user or team, or change its priority.

assignedTo.description: `user:<id>`, `team:<id>`, or `team:<slug>`. `null` unassigns. `whoami` returns your user ID.

ignoreCount.description: Occurrences before the issue stops being ignored. Only with ignoreMode `untilOccurrenceCount`.

ignoreDurationMinutes.description: Minutes to ignore the issue. Only with ignoreMode `forDuration`.

ignoreMode.description: When an ignored issue comes back. `untilEscalating` is the Sentry UI default. The `forDuration`, `untilOccurrenceCount`, and `untilUserCount` modes need their matching ignore fields.

ignoreUserCount.description: Affected users before the issue stops being ignored. Only with ignoreMode `untilUserCount`.

ignoreUserWindowMinutes.description: Window in minutes for ignoreUserCount. Omit to count all users.

ignoreWindowMinutes.description: Window in minutes for ignoreCount. Omit to count all occurrences.

inCommit.description: SHA of a commit Sentry knows that fixes the issue. Requires status `resolved` and inCommitRepository.

inCommitRepository.description: Repository of inCommit as Sentry names it, e.g. `getsentry/sentry`.

inRelease.description: Full version of the release that fixes the issue, exactly as find_releases returns it (e.g. `my-app@1.2.3+45`). Requires status `resolved`. Events from newer releases reopen it as a regression.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

priority.description: The new issue priority. Setting it stops Sentry from changing it automatically.

reason.description: Posted as a comment on the issue's activity.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

conditionGroup.description: Replaces all detection conditions; keep existing IDs. Static and Percent use threshold conditions, including a resolved one. Dynamic uses one anomaly_detection condition.

comparison.description: Threshold value. For Percent detection it is an absolute percentage of the earlier window: 110 means 10% higher.

config.description: Detection config fields to change. Static and Dynamic clear the comparison delta; a new detection type needs a matching condition group.

monitorId.description: Metric Monitor ID from find_metric_monitors, not a legacy metric alert ID.

query.description: Query fields to change; omitted fields are kept and a null environment clears the filter. A new dataset needs a matching aggregate and eventTypes.

dataset.description: `metrics` is crash-free releases. `events_analytics_platform` covers spans, logs, and application metrics, chosen by eventTypes.
